name: You
title: The Querent
bio: Newest of the Club, and the only member with a shingle on a door.

name: Ambrose Quill
title: The Hermit
bio: Keeps the Club's records and hands out its work. Speaks slowly on purpose, so you will hear the part he leaves out.

name: Wren Falkirk
title: The Star
bio: Quartermaster. Everything the Club owns passes through her ledger, and she remembers every line of it.

name: Bryce Halloran
title: The Tower
bio: Constabulary, once. Watches the doors and tells you which factions have noticed you this week.

name: Ilma Voss
title: The Moon
bio: Advanced twice in a year and will not discuss the second time. Knows more about digestion than anyone alive should have needed to learn.

name: Constable Rell
title: Ashfen Row beat
bio: Twenty years on the same six streets. Not stupid — incurious, which is cheaper.

name: Ilsabet Crane
title: The complainant
bio: The dead man's sister-in-law. Paid the Club's fee out of a jar she had been saving for a headstone.

name: Cass Whitlow
title: Halloway's apprentice
bio: Nineteen, quick with figures, and has not slept.

name: Mrs. Peale
title: Your landlady
bio: Collects on the day, not the day after.

name: Mr. Vane
title: Collector
bio: Buys sealed things. Nobody has established what he does with them.

name: Ezra Halloway
title: Deceased
bio: Pawnbroker of Ashfen Row for thirty-one years. Took in one thing he should not have.

name: Sil Mowbray
title: Ash ferry hand
bio: Knows the river's timetable and everyone who has ever missed it. Sells both.
